# AI Research Papers - Evgenii Kniazev

> Repository of pre-prints and research papers on artificial intelligence, machine learning, and autonomous systems by Evgenii Kniazev.

## Topics Covered

- Large language models (LLMs): architecture, fine-tuning, alignment, inference
- Autonomous AI agents: planning, tool use, multi-agent coordination
- Machine learning systems: distributed training, serving, MLOps
- Applied AI: retrieval-augmented generation, code generation, human-AI interaction

## Structure

- papers/ - Full paper PDFs and LaTeX source
- abstracts/ - Plain-text abstracts for each paper
- supplementary/ - Associated code, datasets, and experiments

## How to Use

Browse the papers/ directory for published and pre-print research. Each paper directory contains the PDF, abstract, and any supplementary code or data. See README.md for a table of all publications with links.

## Author

Evgenii Kniazev - https://github.com/keugenek
